candidates.name: Hello Work job information data service
candidates.reason: The structured CSV/API service requires an application and is limited to eligible local authorities, training bodies and licensed/notified employment-placement businesses. Do not automate against it unless the project later qualifies and obtains access.

candidates.name: MLIT Real Estate Information Library API
candidates.reason: Official public API intended for web services/research. Useful for area/property-market context, not live short-term rental inventory.

candidates.name: Commercial Japan job boards
candidates.reason: Do not scrape or republish a commercial board by default. Prefer a documented API/feed, affiliate/partner agreement, or direct employer source with suitable terms.

candidates.name: Commercial housing portals/share-house operators
candidates.reason: Do not scrape or republish inventory by default. Approve providers individually when a documented feed/API/partner route or suitable permission is available.

candidates.name: Direct employer public job listing policy
candidates.reason: Permits concise metadata from original employer/employer-authorised pages discovered through ordinary web search. Commercial aggregators remain non-canonical unless separately approved.

candidates.name: Direct housing provider public listing policy
candidates.reason: Permits concise metadata from original property operator/provider pages discovered through ordinary web search. Commercial aggregators remain non-canonical unless separately approved.
